Valentango Concerto: Orquesta Típica Tarareando at Sausalito Women's Club
events.description:
On Valentine’s Day, Orquesta Típica Tarareando brings Buenos Aires to Sausalito!
An intimate afternoon concert featuring a diverse program of classic and modern tangos for both dancing and listening. Bring a Valentine, a friend, or simply your love of music for an afternoon of heart, harmony, and gratitude. Light Argentine-inspired treats, and a no-host bar with bubbles and other beverages.
Proceeds benefit Sausalito Woman's Club Scholarship Recognition Fund’s 70-year tradition of supporting local scholars and sustaining access to higher education through community-driven support.
